login.title: Sign In
login.description: Sign in to your We-Fly account to access your paragliding logbook, track flights, and analyze your flight data.

register.title: Create Account
register.description: Join We-Fly today and start tracking your paragliding flights with professional-grade analytics and flight logging tools.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot Password
forgotPassword.description: Reset your We-Fly password. Enter your email to receive a password reset link.

resetPassword.title: Reset Password
resetPassword.description: Create a new password for your We-Fly account. Enter your new password to regain access to your paragliding logbook.

verifyEmail.title: Verify Email
verifyEmail.description: Verify your email address to activate your We-Fly account and start tracking your paragliding flights.

consent.title: Privacy Consent
consent.description: Review and provide consent for data processing to create your We-Fly account. Your privacy is important to us.

connect.title: Copy device password
connect.description: Copy your We-Fly instrument device password onto this phone, ready to paste into your vario or sync app.

passwordMeter.hint: use 12+ chars, mix cases, add a number

feedback.hasUppercase: Add at least one uppercase letter (A-Z)
feedback.hasLowercase: Add at least one lowercase letter (a-z)
feedback.hasSpecial: Add at least one special character (!@#$%^&*)
feedback.noCommonPassword: This password is too common, choose something unique
feedback.noSequential: Contains sequential patterns. Avoid patterns like "abcd", "1234", "qwerty"

feedback.multipleAt: Email can only contain one @ symbol
feedback.missingUser: Email must have a username before @
feedback.missingDomain: Email must have a domain after @
feedback.missingPeriod: Email domain must include a period (e.g., .com)
feedback.disposable: Disposable email addresses are not allowed. Please use a permanent email.

inApp.title: Open this page in your browser
inApp.body: We-fly is open inside {appName}. Signing in with Google won't work in {appName}'s built-in browser. Open the page in Chrome or Safari to continue.

connect.title: Device password

unsubscribe.title: Stop tips to get started?
unsubscribe.body: These are the occasional emails that help you get more out of We-Fly, like a reminder when your logbook is still empty. Account and security emails keep coming.
unsubscribe.bodyInvalid: It may have been copied only in part. You can change which emails you get from your profile at any time.
unsubscribe.doneTitle: You won't get tips like this anymore.
unsubscribe.doneBody: Changed your mind? Turn them back on under <link>Profile → Emails</link>.
